package ingest
import "github.com/peasant-labs/peasant/third_party/zombiezen-sqlite"
func buildTaggedBlobAliases(conn *sqlite.Conn, buffer []byte) error {
	open := conn.OpenBlob
	blob, err := open("main", "event", "data", 1, false)
	if err != nil { return err }
	defer blob.Close()
	read := blob.Read
	_, err = read(buffer)
	return err
}
